name: nautilus-compass
description: Reliability layer for multi-agent setups — keep agents coordinating without an orchestrator. Cross-dialog contracts + drift detection + black-box memory (no LLM extraction).
summaryZh: Reliability layer for multi-agent setups — keep agents coordinating without an orchestrator. Cross-dialog contracts + drift detection + black-box memory (no LLM extraction). 这类项目更偏执行与编排，适合搭自动化工作流或多代理系统。
